worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 60,000.00 + military retirement pay (person 0) 50,000.00 + taxable Social Security 10,200.00 = 120,200.00. Federal taxable income = 120,200.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 87,100.00 (the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 40 (filing status married filing jointly): line 7 federal AGI 120,200.00. Line 8 additions 0.00; line 9 = 120,200.00 + 0.00 = 120,200.00. Form 39R Part B line 7 Social Security and railroad benefits included in federal income = 10,200.00 + 0.00 = 10,200.00. Line 8 retirement benefits deduction: line 8a 72,324.00; line 8b railroad benefits received 0.00; line 8c Social Security received (gross, both spouses, Box 5) 12,000.00; line 8d = 72,324.00 - 0.00 - 12,000.00, not below zero, = 60,324.00; line 8e (person 0 age 66: 50,000.00 qualifies, age 62 or older) = 50,000.00; line 8f smaller of 8d and 8e = 50,000.00. Line 18 health insurance premiums: none in the inputs, 0.00. Line 24 total subtractions = 10,200.00 + 50,000.00 = 60,200.00. Form 40 line 10 60,200.00; line 11 total adjusted income = 120,200.00 - 60,200.00 = 60,000.00. Line 12a boxes checked 1. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 31,500.00; line 4 31,500.00; line 5 1 x 1,600.00 = 1,600.00; line 6 33,100.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 33,100.00. Line 17 = 60,000.00 - 33,100.00 = 26,900.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 26,900.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 26,900.00; line 2 9,622.00; line 3 = 17,278.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 17,278.00 x 5.3% = 915.734, to the cent 915.73 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 916; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-24 credits 0.00; line 25 0.00; line 26 915.73. Food Tax Credit Worksheet (Form 40 line 43): 2 x 155.00 = 310.00. State income tax = 915.73 - 310.00 = 605.73. Line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax 10.00 is on the return but the projection does not charge it (approximations). Line 18 would take any federal Schedule 1-A amount, the senior deduction included; it is ignored here and the projection does not subtract it (approximations).
